name: drobon-aegis-ai
description: Drobon Aegis AI — cumulative security product foundation with Developer and Student workspaces (Pump 18).

scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @drobon/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @drobon/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @drobon/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @drobon/worker && npm run typecheck --workspace @drobon/web
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @drobon/shared && npm run test --workspace @drobon/shared && npm run test --workspace @drobon/api && npm run test --workspace @drobon/worker && npm run test --workspace @drobon/web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @drobon/shared && npm run build --workspace @drobon/api && npm run build --workspace @drobon/worker && npm run build --workspace @drobon/web
scripts.preview: npm run build --workspace @drobon/web && npm run preview --workspace @drobon/web
scripts.start:api: npm run build --workspace @drobon/api && npm run start --workspace @drobon/api
